fields.name: Alien Registration Number. (A. Number).
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. 1. Enter Alien Registration Number. (A. Number).

help.instructions: Your alien registration number (A-Number) is a 7-9 digit number found on your green card or other immigration documents. It begins with an 'A'.

fields.name: U S C I S Online Account Number, if any
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. 2. Enter U S C I S Online Account Number, if any.

help.instructions: Your USCIS online account number is a 12-character identifier if you have previously filed a form online. You can find it in your account profile or on the Account Access Notice.

fields.name: Family Name (Last Name)
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Your Full Name. NOTE: Your card will be issued in this name. 3. A. Enter Family Name (Last Name).

help.instructions: Enter your family name (last name) as it appears on your official documents.

fields.name: Given Name (First Name).
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Your Full Name. 3. B. Enter Given Name (First Name).

help.instructions: Enter your given name (first name) as it appears on your official documents.

fields.name: Middle Name
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Your Full Name. 3. C. Enter Middle Name.

help.instructions: Enter your middle name as it appears on your official documents. If you do not have a middle name, enter 'N/A'.

fields.name: Has Your Name Legally Changed?

options.label: Not Applicable - I never received my previous card

fields.spoken_name: Has your name legally changed since the issuance of your Permanent Resident Card?

help.instructions: Indicate if your name has legally changed since your Permanent Resident Card was issued. Select 'Yes' if it has, 'No' if it hasn't, or 'N/A' if you never received your previous card.

fields.name: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Provide your name exactly as it is printed on your current Permanent Resident Card. NOTE:  Attach all evidence of your legal name change with this application. 5. A. Enter Family Name (Last Name).
fields.spoken_name: previous family name as printed on green card

help.instructions: Enter your family name exactly as it appears on your current Permanent Resident Card. This is required if your name has legally changed.

fields.name: Given Name (First Name).
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Provide your name exactly as it is printed on your current Permanent Resident Card. 5. B. Enter Given Name (First Name).
fields.spoken_name: previous given name as printed on green card

help.instructions: Enter your given name exactly as it appears on your current Permanent Resident Card. This is required if your name has legally changed.

fields.name: Middle Name
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Provide your name exactly as it is printed on your current Permanent Resident Card. 5. C. Enter Middle Name.
fields.spoken_name: previous middle name as printed on green card

help.instructions: Enter your middle name exactly as it appears on your current Permanent Resident Card. This is required if your name has legally changed.

fields.name: In Care Of Name

help.instructions: Enter the name of the person or organization if the mail is delivered to someone other than yourself.

help.instructions: Enter the street number and name of your mailing address.

fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Mailing Address. 6. C. Enter Apartment, Suite, or Floor Number.

fields.name: City or Town

help.instructions: Enter the city or town of your mailing address.

fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Mailing Address. 6. E. Select State from List of States.

help.instructions: Select the state of your mailing address from the dropdown menu.

fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Mailing Address. 6. F. Enter ZIP Code.

help.instructions: Enter the province of your mailing address, if applicable. This is usually for addresses outside the United States.

fields.name: Postal Code
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Mailing Address. 6. H. Enter Postal Code.

fields.name: Country

fields.name: ZIP Code
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Physical Address. 7. E. Enter ZIP Code.

help.instructions: Enter the 5-digit ZIP code of your physical address.

fields.name: Province

help.instructions: Enter the province of your physical address, if applicable. This is usually for addresses outside the United States.

fields.name: Postal Code
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Physical Address. 7. G. Enter Postal Code.

help.instructions: Enter the postal code of your physical address, if applicable. This is usually for addresses outside the United States.

fields.name: Country
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Physical Address. 7. H. Enter Country.

help.instructions: Enter the country of your physical address.
Indicate your sex as it appears on your birth certificate.

fields.name: as 2-digit Month, 2-digit Day, and 4-digit Year.
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 9. Enter Date of Birth. Enter as 2-digit Month, 2-digit Day, and 4-digit Year.

help.instructions: Enter your date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format.

fields.name: City / Town / Village of Birth
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 10. Enter City / Town / Village of Birth.
fields.spoken_name: city town or village of birth

help.instructions: Enter the city, town, or village where you were born.

fields.name: Country of Birth
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 11. Enter Country of Birth.

help.instructions: Enter the country where you were born.

fields.name: Given Name (First Name)
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. Mother's Name. 12. Enter Given Name (First Name).

help.instructions: Enter your mother's given name or first name.

fields.name: Given Name (First Name)
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. Father's Name. 13. Enter Given Name (First Name).

help.instructions: Enter your father's given name or first name.

fields.name: Class of Admission
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 14. Enter Class of Admission.

help.instructions: Enter the three-character code for the immigrant category under which you were granted lawful permanent resident or conditional permanent resident status. This code can be found on your Permanent Resident Card.

fields.name: as 2-digit Month, 2-digit Day, and 4-digit Year.
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 15. Enter Date of Admission. Enter as 2-digit Month, 2-digit Day, and 4-digit Year.

help.instructions: Enter the date on which you were granted lawful permanent resident or conditional permanent resident status in MM/DD/YYYY format.

fields.name: U. S. Social Security Number, if any
fields.label: Part 1. Information About You. Additional Information. 16. Enter U. S. Social Security Number, if any.

help.instructions: Enter your 9-digit U.S. Social Security Number, if any.
Indicate your current status as a Lawful Permanent Resident, Permanent Resident - In Commuter Status, or Conditional Permanent Resident. Select only one.

fields.name: Enter City or Town and State
fields.label: Part 2. Application Type. Reason for Application (select only one box). Section A. (To be used only by a lawful permanent resident or a permanent resident in commuter status.) 2. H. 1. A. My Port of Entry (P O E) into the United States will be.  Enter City or Town and State.
fields.spoken_name: commuter status port of entry city and state

help.instructions: Enter the City and State of your Port-of-Entry into the United States. This is needed if you are a permanent resident who is taking up commuter status.

fields.name: Select My previous card has been lost, stolen, or destroyed

options.label: My name or other biographic information has been legally changed since issuance of my existing card
My existing card has already expired or will expire within six months
I have reached my 14th birthday and am registering as required. My existing card will expire AFTER my 16th birthday.
I have reached my 14th birthday and am registering as required. My existing card will expire BEFORE my 16th birthday.
My existing card has incorrect data because of Department of Homeland Security
My previous card has been lost, stolen, or destroyed
My previous card was issued but never received
My existing card has been mutilated
I have a prior edition of the Alien Registration Card, or I am applying to replace my current Permanent Resident Card for a reason that is not specified above
I am a commuter who is taking up actual residence in the United States
I have been automatically converted to lawful permanent resident status
I am a permanent resident who is taking up commuter status

help.instructions: Select why you need a new card

fields.name: Select My previous card was issued but never received
fields.label: Part 2. Application Type. Reason for Application (select only one box). Section B. (To be used only by a conditional permanent resident.) 3. B. Select My previous card was issued but never received.

options.label: My previous card was issued but never received

fields.spoken_name: my previous card was issued but never received

help.instructions: Select this reason if you never received your card. Submit a copy of the latest Form I-797 for Form I-485 or Form I-90 that should have resulted in issuance of your Permanent Resident Card.

fields.name: Location where you applied for an immigrant visa or adjustment of status
fields.label: Part 3. Processing Information. 1. Enter Location where you applied for an immigrant visa or adjustment of status.
fields.spoken_name: location where you applied for immigrant visa

help.instructions: Enter the location where you applied for an immigrant visa or adjustment of status. List the location of the U.S. Embassy, U.S. Consulate, or USCIS office.

fields.name: Location where your immigrant visa was issued or U S C I S office where you were granted adjustment of status
fields.label: Part 3. Processing Information. 2. Enter Location where your immigrant visa was issued or U S C I S office where you were granted adjustment of status.
fields.spoken_name: location where immigrant visa was issued

help.instructions: Enter the location where your immigrant visa was issued or USCIS office where you were granted adjustment of status. List the location of the U.S. Embassy, U.S. Consulate, or USCIS office.

fields.name: Destination in the United States at time of admission
fields.label: Part 3. Processing Information. Complete Item Numbers 3. A. and 3. A. 1. if you entered the United States with an immigrant visa. (If you were granted adjustment of status, proceed to Item Number 4.) 3. A. Enter Destination in the United States at time of admission.

help.instructions: Enter your destination in the United States at the time of admission.

fields.name: City or Town and State
fields.label: Part 3. Processing Information. Complete Item Numbers 3. A. and 3. A. 1. if you entered the United States with an immigrant visa. help.instructions: Enter the City or Town and State of the Port-of-Entry where you were admitted to the United States.

fields.name: Additional Information
fields.spoken_name: Have you ever been in exclusion, deportation, or removal proceedings or ordered removed from the United States?

help.instructions: Select 'Yes' if you have ever been in exclusion, deportation, or removal proceedings otherwise select 'No'.

fields.name: Additional Information
fields.spoken_name: Since you were granted permanent residence, have you ever filed Form I-407, Abandonment by Alien of Status as Lawful Permanent Resident, or otherwise been judged to have abandoned your status?

help.instructions: Select 'No' if you have not filed Form I-407, Abandonment by Alien of Status as Lawful Permanent Resident, or otherwise been determined to have abandoned your status. Select 'Yes' if you have.
Select one option for ethnicity.

options.label: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

help.instructions: Select all applicable races.
